_comments: The Forms submit outbox (#303). FormSubmissionEngine publishes one message here per FINAL
submit, and one per partial save of a version that has OnPartial automations (#303 spec section 12),
inside the submit transaction (a DatabaseProviderBase publish enlists in the caller's
transaction), so the response and its 'run my automations' message commit together or not at
all. That replaces the detached promise that a killed process could lose.
Database transport: it is the one every host has, and it is what makes the enlisted publish
possible. IsFifo false: automation runs for different responses are independent. External
publish is off: only the submit engine may announce a submission. The payload is ids only
(ResponseID, FormVersionID, FormDistributionID, Trigger, PartialSaveKey), far under the payload cap.
The deduplication key is the response id for a final submit and <responseId>:partial:<key> for a
partial save; both are built by forms-core-entities-server's work-queue/response-submitted.ts,
the one definition the publisher and the Forms.RunAutomations handler share.

fields.Name: forms.response-submitted
fields.Description: MJ Forms: one message per final response submission, and one per partial save of a version with OnPartial automations, published in the submit transaction. Payload { ResponseID, FormVersionID, FormDistributionID, Trigger, PartialSaveKey }; DeduplicationKey is the response id (final) or <responseId>:partial:<key> (partial).
